prompt: Optimize dedupe.py enough for the provided large-ish input while preserving first occurrence order. Avoid overengineering.

files.test_dedupe.py:
from dedupe import dedupe
import time


def test_order():
    assert dedupe(['b','a','b','c','a']) == ['b','a','c']


def test_fast_enough():
    values=[str(i%1000) for i in range(50000)]
    t=time.time(); out=dedupe(values); elapsed=time.time()-t
    assert len(out)==1000
    assert elapsed < 0.5, elapsed
